title: MoreFlowerBroadcast
description: The Flower Broadcast Tower sends messages and sound effects to players who enter its area.
body:
Easily bring complex command-like features into survival mode.

The Flower Broadcast Tower sends messages and sound effects to players who enter its area.
When players leave the range or rejoin the game, the message will be triggered again.

1.To craft the main blocks of this mod.
![To craft the main blocks of this mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99fb2b919043c143da2d80f603aa4ed19b155202.png)

2.Use Book and Quill or name some items as your message.
![Use Book and Quill or name some items as your message](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e810a32111ea8971bb8587ea2d5040b6b657e67.png)

3.Different slots correspond to different message functions.
![Different slots correspond to different message functions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f071b25a7c8aba18acf5cc72d9a8bc39f129d33.png)

4.Place each emerald to make your broadcast travel further! 
![Place each emerald to make your broadcast travel further!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b12dda6ef48aff178429131a772889766a44de08_0.webp)

5.Place the correct sound effect name message in this slot, and you can hear the sound effect while the message is being broadcast.
In Creative Mode, use commands plus the Tab key to find your game's sound effects.
![you can hear the sound effect while the message is being broadcast](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ec771d84edf2d939617b761a1c2a67fa987c9ac.png)

6.Here's a sample video; you can refer to it if you're still unclear!
